sources.title: Rock Climbing in Seonin-bong (Dobongsan), Seoul/Gyeonggi-do (Northwest Korea)
sources.publisher: Mountain Project 社群頁（Chan Kim 分享）
sources.evidence: 讀了 Description、Getting There 與路線清單（未讀照片說明與留言）。Description：「Seonin-bong is located in Dobongsan, which is located in the northeastern part of Bukhansan National Park. sources.evidence: 讀了 Description、Getting There 與路線清單（未讀照片說明與留言）。Description：「Seonin-bong is located in Dobongsan, which is located in the northeastern part of Bukhansan National Park.
